items.title: Paramount Q2: Advertisers Drive Double-Digit Upfront Growth
items.summary: Paramount Skydance says it had the strongest upfront ad results since the CBS-Viacom merger. The company posted a 9% decline in total ad revenue for Q2, to $1.94 billion.

items.title: Paramount–Warner Bros. Discovery judge sets March 2027 trial date for antitrust fight
items.summary: A federal judge has set a March 2027 trial date for the antitrust challenges to Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: Antitrust Trial Over Paramount-Warner Merger Set for March
items.summary: A California federal judge said Tuesday that the antitrust trial will begin March 2 with an expectation that it will run for 12 court days.  The timeline the judge laid out in a written order is much later than the November 2026 start date Paramount had sought.  California Attorney General  Rob Bonta  had petitioned for an April 2027 start.
